title: I tripped while running at recess, but then I didn't cry.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: I tripped while running at recess, but then I didn't cry.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Were you okay after you fell?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: I was fine, and I didn't even need a bandage.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: It was just a small scrape on my knee.

variations: "tripped" 换 "dropped my lunch"；"cry" 换 "give up"。
